title: console(studio): the Studio landing copy and the console guide still offer an "org overlay" (组织覆盖), the per-organization axis ADR-0131 D6 retired
body:
Filing class: **① a user-visible defect with a named landing spot**: shipped copy states a capability the platform retired. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_016djJF12Qt14ejKR5Vjt4sK`). PR objectui#12168's contract review (`6115701744`, ③ item 3) and its dev's out-of-scope finding raised it.

## The reading

[ADR-0131](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0131-total-organization-ownership-no-null-organization-id.md) D6, objectstack `main`, line 105: "ADR-0005's per-organization overlay axis is retired". objectstack-ai/objectstack#22340 S2 renames the registry flag to say what it now means, "may an environment overlay this packaged item" (`allowOrgOverride` → `allowEnvironmentOverlay`). PR objectui#12168 carries objectui's read of that rename.

Read at that PR's head `2c38817`, which leaves these lines as they are:
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`. The Studio home shows these strings, so every Studio user reads them:
  - en `:3019` `engine.studio.landing.description`: "… customize them with an org overlay."
  - en `:3032` `engine.studio.landing.readonlyHint`: "Customize one with an org overlay, for the metadata types that accept one."
  - en `:3034` `engine.studio.landing.overlayTitle`: "… each type shows whether it accepts an org overlay".
  - zh `:6229`, `:6241` and `:6243`: the same three keys, which say 「组织覆盖」.
- `content/docs/guide/console.md:37` (product docs, row "Read-only Packages in Studio"): "Whether an item can take an org overlay is decided per metadata type (`allowEnvironmentOverlay`)". The PR renamed the key on this line and kept the old noun beside it.
- Code comments that say "per-org overlay" or "ORG OVERLAY" next to the renamed key. These are not user-visible; the acting dev decides whether they ride along.

## Direction

- The copy names the axis that exists: an environment overlay, in both packs, and in the guide row.
- ⛔ No new keys. The values change, and so do the other eight packs if they carry these keys.
- ⛔ Wording only. Which items the overlay can reach is objectui#12169's question.

**Acting reader:** the `domain:ui` seat 1 claims this card after PR objectui#12168 merges, because that PR holds `i18n.ts` and `console.md`. Its dev measures every pack and every user-visible string, then changes the copy in one PR.

## Dedupe

- objectui issues updated since 2026-10-01, 456 of them, read by REST list. Titles matched for `overlay`, `per-org`, `org override`, `0131` and `wording`.
- Hits:
  - objectui#12141, the rename itself (control).
  - objectui#12169, the artifact-tier Edit offer (a different defect).
  - objectui#11781, objectui#11530 and objectui#10380, all closed. Each is a different subject.
- None of them is about this copy.
